name: Over-the-Shoulder Glance
editorial: A candid high-fashion editorial shot, dynamic natural movement, confident glamour posing.
body: 3/4 back to the camera, weight shifted onto one leg, spine gently curved, showing the line of the back.
head: turned over the shoulder toward the camera, chin slightly down.
pose: one hand at the hip, the other relaxed; glancing back over the shoulder, mid-motion.
